name: ERC-3643 / T-REX — permissioned token compliance surface
description: Harvest target. ERC-3643 gates transfers behind an on-chain identity registry and a compliance contract; this door records what would be measured about that machinery.

upstream.relationship: none; no endorsement by the T-REX association or any issuer is implied

measurement_plan.unit: one deployed token contract, not one token holding
measurement_plan.why_not_balances: Balances are already visible on any block explorer. The non-obvious fact about a permissioned token is whether the compliance machinery it claims is present and callable.
checks: identity_registry_resolves — the token names an identity registry and that address returns code
compliance_contract_resolves — the token names a compliance contract and that address returns code
modules_enumerable — the compliance modules bound to the token can be listed
transfer_gated — a transfer path that is refused for a non-verified identity is observable

handling_of_negative_readings.rule: A compliance contract that does not resolve is recorded UNMEASURED, never as a finding that the issuer is non-compliant.
handling_of_negative_readings.why: We can observe whether a contract answers. We cannot observe whether an issuer has met a legal obligation. Conflating the two turns a reader into a regulator.

what_this_does_not_establish: No T-REX deployment has been read by the Council of AI at this as_of.
No issuer of an ERC-3643 token is a client.
A resolving compliance contract is not evidence of regulatory compliance, and a non-resolving one is not evidence of its absence.
doctrine: Measure the machinery, not the obligation. UNMEASURED is first-class.
